title: Eighth Xhosa War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Eighth Xhosa War", at revision 1370616740, opens: "The Eighth Xhosa War was a war between the British Empire and Xhosa as well as Khoikhoi forces, between 1850 and 1853. It was the eighth of nine Xhosa Wars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q20612501, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1850–1853 war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
